description: Modest fashion brand designing abayas and hijabs for Muslim women in the West, sold direct through its own Shopify store with a structured ambassador program for creators.

evidence.summary: The brand's own ambassador page publishes the program: Content Creator affiliates earn 10% commission on every completed order with a 30-day cookie and no approval needed, rising through tiers to 12% (15+ orders/month) and 15% (30+ orders/month), paid monthly on the 15th via PayPal (min $50) or Wise (min $100).

The same official page states verbatim: 'Receive 10% commission on every completed order through your unique link — accurately tracked, no cap on earnings.' That explicit no-cap statement on the brand's own program page is why commission_cap is recorded as uncapped.

The program is built for creators: the page welcomes Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, blog and newsletter promotion, allows boosting your own posts, and active ambassadors at 15+ sales/month receive gifted pieces plus ready-to-use campaign assets for Ramadan, Eid and launches.
The official page publishes the affiliate team's email, Affiliate@mariam-col.com, for program assignment questions, paid-search approvals and coupon-platform registration.

Onboarding mechanics from the same page: everyone starts as a Starter Ambassador at 5% with a 7-day cookie during a 3-5 business day review, and confirmed orders are backdated to the 10% Content Creator rate once assigned; a separate Paid & Deal track pays a flat 5% with a 7-day cookie to approved search/coupon partners.
